items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Black Dot had the place there where there used to a guy named Gap-Eye used to have a Cadillac. He'd go out all the time when I was hanging out with Doc Hawkins.

ctx.x: Jimmy Blanton died. I was to the hospital because Black Dot had the place there where there used to a guy named Gap-Eye used to have a Cadillac. He'd go out all the time when I was hanging out with Doc Hawkins.
Do you know what year that was, Jo?
